title: Using a plastic reed during the war
summary: Hall explains he switched to plastic reeds because cane reeds were hard to get and warped in wartime.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I think it's on alright now. I'm going to have Ralph ask you a few questions too, that's why I have answers.

Well, I rolled a little list out of questions. I'd like to ask you on that. One was that Bill said that the reed is concerned. Did you ever use a plastic reed? Yeah, I did. Did you not have any successions?

Well, I tell you the reason why I used a plastic reed is because I had to use it because during the war you couldn't get no reed. You see, you could buy a reed but you had to buy so many of them to get a good one. And those that you would get a regular reed, it was made so long that it was all dried out. The minute it was soaked, it would all curve. You know what I mean? I had a lot of trouble with them. So rather than having all that trouble, I just went to a plastic reed. Yeah, yeah. Well, that's alright. Yeah. Yeah.
But when after the war, did you go back to the reed? I went back to the regular...
